transcript: W: Ian, Colin, thanks for coming in early. Most of last month's customer complaints were about late deliveries.
M1: Those are mostly sofa orders. Our truck only holds four at a time, and it's fully booked until the end of the month.
W: Colin, weren't you going to look into hiring a second delivery company?
M2: I did. On most of our sofas, they'd charge more per delivery than we actually make on the sale.
M1: Then why not let customers collect their sofas from the warehouse themselves? Plenty of them have asked about that.
W: I like that. We could even take 10% off for anyone who picks up.
M2: The loading dock is closed to the public on weekends, though, and most people would want to come on a Saturday.
W: Then let's offer it on weekdays only, for now. Colin, could you put together a sign for the showroom explaining the offer?
M2: Sure. I'll have a draft ready this afternoon, and I'll ask Ian to check the wording.

transcript: W: Hi, I need to send this box of fabric samples to a client. It has to get there by Thursday at the latest.
M: Since today's Monday, you can rule out our standard service. Anything else on this chart will arrive in time.
W: I'd like to avoid the air services if I can. My manager wants us to keep shipping costs to a minimum.
M: Before you decide, ground shipments to that area are running a day behind this week. There's road construction on the main highway.
W: Oh. Then ground won't work at all.
M: I'm afraid not. The air services aren't affected, though.
W: All right, I'll pay for air, but not overnight. Thursday is soon enough.
M: Sure. Once the box is scanned, I'll e-mail you a tracking number you can forward to your client.
W: Perfect. My e-mail is on this business card.

transcript: W: Good morning, and welcome to Hollis Glassworks. My name is Dana, and I'll be showing you around for the next hour.

W: Trust me, you won't need your jackets in there.
W: After that, we'll walk through the packing area and stop by the design studio.
W: Feel free to take pictures anywhere except the studio. Some of the pieces there won't be in stores until next spring.
W: Normally we'd finish in our gift shop, but the painters are working in there until Friday.
W: Instead, before you leave, I'll give each of you a card for 10% off anything on our website.
